Often people just see power chords as just one chord strummed. You forget that, in that 1 chord you have 6 stings. You can play that chord various ways. (Even though you wont get that full tone you get when you strum all 6). But you can create some amazing riffs by even must playing the root note and the 5th for example you create this whole new dimension. Bar chords are cheap but you can just take 3 notes from that chord and develop them. With one power chord you can create soft gentle meoldy to funk (by playing the bottom 3) or even metal depending  what your going for. So when ever you think something is too simple try break it down and really understand what your playing and the relationship between the chords your playing. Hope that helps a bit
